maya_dev: Kicking off canary for release v2.17.0 -> serving runtime change (KV-cache heuristics). Rolling to 10% in us-west-2 now. @adrian_sre can you watch SLO panels? I’ll leave tracing on.
deploy-bot: ✅ deploy started: canary 10% for service=embed-service image=redwood/serve:v2.17.0 region=us-west-2. Progress updates will follow. Change window: 30m.
jen_oncall: :eyes: noticing p95 jump for embed-service in us-west-2 right after rollout start. Up ~150ms vs baseline. 5xx count also ticked up.
adrian_sre: pulling metrics now. quick query (10m):
```
rate(errors{service="embed-service",region="us-west-2"}[10m])
/ rate(requests{service="embed-service",region="us-west-2"}[10m]) * 100
```
Looks like 5xx ~0.8% in the canary cohort (baseline ~0.1%).
samir_ops: Can we confirm it's only canary pods and not infra? Any CPU/OOM or memory pressure? Also run synthetic hits against embed-service /v1/embeds?region=us-west-2
ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert triggered: alert=embed_service_5xx_rate region=us-west-2 value=0.82% threshold=0.5% window=10m
maya_dev: Pausing rollout. Do not advance to 25%. Pin traffic back to stable for user-facing traffic. Can @deploy-bot run a traffic-split to 100% -> redwood/serve:v2.16.9 for embed-service in us-west-2 only?
adrian_sre: Agree with pause. Also check a small config mismatch in the new runtime that can cause short-lived 503s on cold starts for certain sequence lengths. Repro steps in the runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/embed-503s
samir_ops: Running synth now and executing traffic pin.
samir_ops: ```
# traffic pin command
deployctl traffic set --service embed-service --region us-west-2 --version v2.16.9 --percent 100 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```
deploy-bot: Executing traffic operation: set 100% -> v2.16.9 for embed-service us-west-2. Started at 1981234578. (cmd id: op-7c2)
deploy-bot: Completed: traffic set 100% -> v2.16.9 for embed-service us-west-2 (duration 38s).
jen_oncall: Monitoring panels: p95 and 5xx back to baseline within 4m. Synth tests pass. :thumbsup:
adrian_sre: I'll open a follow-up ticket to roll back the runtime change temporarily and add a config guard for sequence-length path. tagging infra and runtime.
maya_dev: Thanks team. We'll hold this release until we validate the fix. Filing release note: paused canary due to embed-service 5xx spike; rollback to v2.16.9 in us-west-2. Next steps: postmortem if we can't reproduce in staging.
ops-bot: Incident closed: embed_service_5xx_rate (ops link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-1981) closed_by=jen_oncall closed_at=1981234594
maya_dev: Closing thread. Reopening if we see regression during the next window. :white_check_mark:
